name: price-ai-objection-answer
description: Prepares an honest answer when a client says AI could do your work, with their exact words, what is true in them, what they get from you that their AI does not give them, an offer to show your workflow and a reply in your voice. Use for "run price-ai-objection-answer", "AI could do this in 10 seconds", "why are you charging so much", "my client says a chatbot can do this", "answer the AI objection", "how do I defend my fee against AI", "reply to a client who doubts my value", part of the Pricing Under AI Pressure Pack by 90n.
